info.title: Career Quest API
info.description: Career Quest. Recommendations use explicit scoring and validated LLM selection. HR can import profiles/history and inspect aggregate skill gaps and participation. Completion is a stub returning 501. All API routes require X-Role and X-Employee-Id; these headers are trusted development identities.

get.description: Employees ordered by ID, with local recommendation status; no employee ranking.

post.description: Atomically upsert profiles and history; recommendations are immediately available.

employees_file.description: employees.json: dataset envelope or Employee array

get.description: Aggregate current/next-grade gaps, missing steps and participation without ranking people.
Recommend eligible events using explicit scores and validated optional LLM selection.

post.description: Contract stub: no completion, history or skill changes are persisted.

enrolled.title: Enrolled
enrolled.description: All participation records, including completed ones
